item.title: Google Search is now less than half of Alphabet’s revenue
item.description: Search was 49.7% of Alphabet's revenue in Q3 2026, down from 62% in early 2019, as Google Cloud grew much faster. Every quarter since 2018, from Alphabet's earnings releases. (1 source: hackernews)

item.title: Alleged Chinese spy had 'close relationship' with Nvidia boss Jensen Huang
